buttons.sign_in_and_retry: Sign in to YouTube and retry

empty.active: No active download. Add a video and it will start downloading right away.
empty.queue: The queue is empty. Videos added during a download will line up here.

remove_dialog.title: Remove the video?
remove_dialog.message: “{title}” is {percent}% downloaded. The partial file will be deleted from the device, and the download will have to start over.

clear_finished_dialog.title: Clear the downloaded list?
clear_finished_dialog.message: The videos stay in the download folder: only their records and thumbnails are removed from the app.

download_directory.title: Download folder
download_directory.description: Finished videos are saved here. A new folder applies to the next downloads; partial files are kept in the app folder until the download finishes.

network.timeout: YouTube is taking too long to respond.
network.forbidden: YouTube rejected the request (403). Try again: the stream links may have expired.
network.rate_limited: YouTube has temporarily limited requests (429). Please wait a bit.

video.not_youtube_url: This is not a YouTube video link.
video.player_config: YouTube changed the player page: its settings could not be read.
video.unplayable: YouTube does not serve this video ({status}).
video.streams_unavailable: YouTube did not provide direct stream links for this video.
video.player_parse: Could not parse the YouTube player: {error}
video.challenge: Could not solve the YouTube check ({type}): {error}
video.quality_unavailable: The selected quality is no longer available. Add the video again.
video.stream_interrupted: YouTube keeps interrupting the stream download. Try again.
video.web_view_runtime: Downloading requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
video.js_engine: The built-in JavaScript engine (WebView2) returned an error: {error}
video.destination_unavailable: Could not save the file to “{path}”: {error}

authentication.web_view_runtime: Signing in requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
authentication.session_not_issued: Sign-in was not completed: YouTube did not issue account cookies. Try again.

settings.picker: Could not open the folder picker: {error}

download_queue.storage: Could not save the download queue: {error}
